examples.heading: MIDDLE OHIO VALLEY
examples.text: Training thunderstorms along a slow-moving front will produce rainfall rates over 2 inches per hour. Soils are saturated from rain earlier this week, so flash flooding is likely, especially in urban areas and small streams.
